messages.en: Shall we just grill some fish tonight?
Sure! I already bought some fish at the market earlier.
You've got a talent for drawing. Want to enter this competition?
I'd like to, but I'm a bit shy. I've only ever drawn at home.
Have you read my message yet?
Yeah. I'll reply later, okay? I'm eating right now.

senses.en_definition: To come or go back home or to a previous place.
The other side or back of something, especially a side hidden from view.

collocations.en: on the other side of the hill

senses.en_definition: Growing or pointing in the opposite direction to normal.

messages.en: Mum, I'm about to head home. Want me to pick anything up for you?
Could you stop and get some bread? We've run out at home.
Sure, I'll stop by the shop first. Just wait for me at home, Mum.
